assessments.reasoning: MS-VBAL v20250520 PDF page 46 §5.2.1.2 sets the module default for each affected array dimension with an omitted lower bound, and the final static-semantics clause sets that default to zero if the module omits Option Base.

challenge.method: Read each static-semantics clause, compared absent and present directives and explicit bounds, and challenged the scope using the product reference's ParamArray and qualified VBA.Array cases (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/language/reference/user-interface-help/option-base-statement). Checked the catalog's 2.4 release row against the PDF footer.
challenge.results: An allowed Option Base 1 changes the relevant default, and an explicit lower bound uses its own value. The product reference identifies constructs with distinct rules. The candidate is restricted to the default for applicable dimensions under the 2.4 specification.

limitations: This is a normative module default for affected dimensions in the named specification. Constructor-specific behavior, explicit bounds, and implementation observations require separate evidence.
